meta.name: infrastructure-as-code
meta.description: Use for Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Bicep, ARM, Crossplane, provider constraints, remote state, imports, moved blocks, plan review, drift, policy checks, modular infrastructure, and safe resource changes.

copy.tagline: 用代码定义并自动部署云上基础设施
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果习惯用代码管理云资源并希望变更安全可回滚
copy.tagline_en: Define cloud infrastructure as code and deploy it safely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage cloud resources as code and want safe, reviewable changes

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 通过代码管理云基础设施。它会先查看工作流程文档，核对工具版本、后端状态等细节，再编写或修改基础设施配置，并提供验证命令、风险提示和回滚说明。
howto.when: 当你说到 Terraform、OpenTofu、Pulumi 等基础设施工具，或要求做计划审查、漂移处理等操作时触发。

say.text: 用 Terraform 创建 AWS EC2 实例，并添加安全组规则。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应 IaC 代码并给出验证命令。

say.text: 审核这份 OpenTofu 计划，标出破坏性变更。
say.note: 它会检查计划并汇总风险。

say.text: 用 Pulumi 把现有资源导入状态管理。
say.note: 它会生成导入命令和迁移说明。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude manage cloud infrastructure through code. It first reads the workflow doc, checks tool versions, backend state, etc., then writes or modifies infrastructure config and provides validation commands, risks, and rollback notes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or other infrastructure-as-code tools, or ask for plan review, drift handling, etc.

say_en.text: Create an AWS EC2 instance with security groups using Terraform.
say_en.note: It will generate IaC code and validation commands.

say_en.text: Review this OpenTofu plan and flag destructive changes.
say_en.note: It checks the plan and summarizes risks.

say_en.text: Import existing resources into state management with Pulumi.
say_en.note: It provides import commands and migration notes.
